title: Privacy Policy
intro: With the following Privacy Policy, we would like to inform you about the types of personal data we process (hereinafter also referred to as “data”), the purposes for which we process it, and the scope of such processing. This Privacy Policy applies to data processing on our website (hereinafter referred to as the “online service”).
The terms used are not gender-specific.

consent.heading: Manage Consents
consent.text: This page integrates individual external services only after you have given your consent. You can view and change your selections here at any time and revoke them with future effect.

content.text:
Authorized Representatives:
Elmer Gutierrez, Josina Herding, Hannah Pinell, Frederike Schmidt
Contact Person for Data Protection Issues
The following overview summarizes the types of data processed and the purposes of such processing, and identifies the data subjects.

items: Provision of External Content and Display of Live Data

content.text: Below is an overview of the legal bases on which we process personal data:

Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1), first sentence, subparagraph (f) of the GDPR) – The processing is necessary to safeguard our legitimate interests, in particular the secure provision, analysis, and optimization of our online services.

Processing of Personal Data/Protection of End Devices (Art. 6(1), first sentence, lit. a of the GDPR and § 25(1) of the TDDDG) – Processing is carried out exclusively on the basis of your consent, to the extent that information is stored on or retrieved from your end device for the purpose of analysis.
In accordance with legal requirements, we implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of protection commensurate with the risk.
These measures include, in particular, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data, as well as measures to control access to the data and its processing.
To protect the data you submit through our website, we use SSL encryption. You can recognize encrypted connections by the „https://“ prefix in your browser's address bar.

sections.heading: Provision of the Online Service and Web Hosting

content.text: To provide our online services, we use the services of Strato (STRATO AG, Otto-Ostrowski-Straße 7, 10249 Berlin). In doing so, we process data necessary for the operation and delivery of the website. To the extent required by law, we have entered into a contract with the hosting provider for the processing of personal data on our behalf in accordance with Article 28 of the GDPR.
This includes, in particular, IP addresses that are necessary to transmit content to the user's browser.

items: Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1), first sentence, subparagraph (f) of the GDPR)

sections.heading: Collection of Access Data and Log Files

content.text: We collect data on every access to the server (so-called server log files). This access data includes, in particular, IP addresses, the date and time of the request, the content accessed, and technical information about the browser and operating system used.
This data is processed to ensure the security and stability of our online services (e.g., to defend against attacks).
For security reasons, log file information is stored for a maximum of 14 days and then deleted.

items: Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1), first sentence, subparagraph (f) of the GDPR)

content.text: Based on your consent, we use the web analytics service Matomo to statistically analyze the use of our online platform and to optimize our content and features.
Matomo is hosted on the systems of the hosting provider we have engaged. The analytics data collected is not shared with third parties for their own purposes.

When using Matomo, the following data in particular may be processed: anonymized IP addresses to determine an approximate geographic region, information about the device used and screen resolution, pages and content accessed, referrer information (the previously visited website), scroll depth, interactions with content and features of our online service, and pseudonymous session IDs as well as heatmap data for analyzing the usage and usability of our online offering.

For the purposes of web analytics, users’ IP addresses are processed only briefly when they access our website in order to derive approximate location information (e.g., country or region) through geolocation. The full IP address is not stored. Any other data collected as part of web analytics is stored only for as long as necessary for the stated purposes and is subsequently deleted.
You may revoke your consent at any time, effective for the future, through the settings on our consent banner. The lawfulness of the processing carried out prior to the revocation remains unaffected.

items: Processing of Personal Data/Protection of End Devices (Art. 6(1), first sentence, lit. a of the GDPR and § 25(1) of the TDDDG)

content.text:
Based on your consent, we embed interactive maps to display locations on our website. For this purpose, we use map data from OpenStreetMap, which is provided through the CARTO service.

When the maps are loaded, a connection is established to CARTO’s servers. In particular, your IP address is transmitted to CARTO so that the map content can be delivered to your browser. We have no control over the further processing of the Data by CARTO.

items: Processing of Personal Data/Protection of End Devices (Art. 6(1), first sentence, lit. a of the GDPR and § 25(1) of the TDDDG)

content.text:
Based on your consent, we embed content from the VesselFinder service to display current ship traffic on an interactive map.

The content is embedded using an iframe. When the embedded content loads, a connection is established with VesselFinder’s servers. In particular, your IP address is transmitted to VesselFinder. In addition, VesselFinder may set its own cookies or use similar technologies on the embedded page. We have no control over the nature, scope, or further processing of the data collected in this manner.

items: Provision of External Content and Display of Live Data
Processing of Personal Data/Protection of End Devices (Art. 6(1), first sentence, lit. a of the GDPR and § 25(1) of the TDDDG)

content.text: When you contact us (e.g., by email), the information provided by the person making the inquiry is processed to the extent necessary to respond to the inquiry.

items: Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1), first sentence, subparagraph (f) of the GDPR)

content.text: As a data subject under the GDPR, you have various rights:

items: Withdrawal of consent with future effect

content.text: In addition, you have the right to file a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.heading: Changes and Updates to the Privacy Policy

content.text: We will update the Privacy Policy as soon as changes to our data processing practices make it necessary to do so.
